beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The Fragmented Future asks what happens when AI changes the useful scale of government.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Smaller communities may gain capability while larger authorities gain stronger tools of control.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book explores this tension through historical comparisons and explicitly uncertain scenarios.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its direction is resilient, layered governance rather than a prediction that states will disappear.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Readers can compare political scales without mistaking local independence for automatic freedom.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A city-region could gain tools once available only to a much larger administration.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The same infrastructure might leave it dependent on a distant platform or private owner.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Local autonomy can also expose minorities to local domination or transfer costs beyond a boundary.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book keeps these risks beside the appeal of experimentation and cultural continuity.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That comparison prevents fragmentation from becoming a synonym for freedom.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The proposed response assigns functions according to their consequences, scale, and need for local knowledge.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Some risks require shared capacity, while other decisions benefit from multiple places trying different approaches.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: No level receives permanent supremacy merely because it is smaller or larger.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The historical and future scenarios examine what happens when these arrangements face capture or failure.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: They are instruments for comparison, rather than predictions about which political map must arrive.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Begin with the preface’s double possibility: dispersed capability and more powerful concentration.
